messages:
maria: Hey @aj @sam — I pushed changes for PR #7421 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7421). Addressed the review comments: moved the backoff config to an opt-in env var, added unit+smoke tests, and fixed the race in kv allocator. PTAL when you have cycles. CI passes locally but the linux-integration job is intermittently failing.

aj: Looking now — thanks for the heads up. quick skim first: nice cleaner config.

aj: One tiny nit: can we change the test logging to use debug instead of info? it pollutes test output and the flaky asserts get lost.

maria: Good call — updated to debug and pushed a new commit (sha: b3f9c7a). Re-ran the smoke script, still green locally.

sam: I ran the integration tests against the branch; everything except the windows-serial test failed (same flaky we saw last week). not a blocker for this PR. LGTM from my side. +1

neha: Do we want to put this through the merge-train or schedule a one-off canary? config change might affect Dedicated pools.

maria: Prefer a single canary first, then merge-train if it's clean. low-risk but want to watch tail latency for 30m. target window tonight around 23:00 PT.

jen: I can own merge-ops and monitor the canary. Please add me as the merge custodian in the PR description. also drop the rollback guard note in the changelog.

maria: Added @jen to the PR description and added rollback instructions in the PR body. also added a short smoke checklist: 

```
smoke checklist:
- deploy to canary pool
- run sample load (prefill cache)
- watch per-route 95p latency
- verify kv allocator metrics (no eviction errors)
```

jen: Perfect. I’ll take the 23:00 PT slot. Can someone re-trigger the linux-integration once the flaky is investigated? I don’t want the canary blocked by CI flakes. :thumbsup:

aj: I requeued the linux-integration job (job id 71234) and left a note in the pipeline. if it flakes again we can merge with merge-ops approval after I verify smoke.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by jen for 2024-11-20T06:00:00Z against pool:c-dedicated-2. Notifying oncall.

maria: Thanks everyone — PTAL final time. if no objections I’ll mark as ready-to-merge and assign to @jen for canary.

sam: no objections from me.

aj: LGTM after the debug log change.

maria: Great — marking as ready-to-merge. Will follow up after canary with perf diffs. :rocket:
